mission: Replace with a neutral player goal, such as: starting in this room, reach and move around in the next distinct room. If blocked, report the furthest visible state reached.

controls.input: Replace with an ordinary keyboard or mouse input
controls.purpose: Replace with the visible action it should perform

observationProtocol.initialAccount: Before applying acceptance criteria or receiving targeted follow-up questions, describe the visible scene in concrete spatial terms and call out conspicuous or unexpected details.
observationProtocol.progressAccount: After important actions, record the visible change, whether it advanced the player goal, and the furthest state reached.
interactionCompletion: observe the target and starting relationship
verify the resulting player state with another observation

criteria.name: Replace with the player-level outcome the retained trajectory must support
criteria.evidence: Replace with required before/after, repeated-frame, or terminal-state evidence

insufficientEvidence: Replace with a shallow intermediate effect that does not establish the player outcome, such as a door animation without successful traversal

provenance: replace with the owning Den document, repository document, or prior playtest evidence handle
fieldGuide.observedBuildRevision: replace with the game revision this guide was observed against, when known
fieldGuide.freshness: replace with an observed date or explicit unknown/stale label
fieldGuide.confidence: replace with high, medium, low, or mixed
fieldGuide.notesMarkdown: Replace with the complete current controls, landmarks, spatial relationships, useful strategies, confusing affordances, and failed approaches. Do not include a desired verdict for this mission.
unresolvedQuestions: Replace with an unresolved question, or use an empty array

sourceHandles.purpose: Read on demand if an interaction's local effect may not establish its downstream use

notes: The worker receives the mission, controls, and observation protocol first. When practical it captures the initial scene before reading game-specific guidance. The orchestrator normally maps the retained neutral account to acceptance after that account exists. Field-guide hints never determine acceptance; visible contradictions are retained and the next guide is a complete replacement candidate. Label any diagnostic influence.
